text:
**Nationwide FlexDirect pays the highest rate I found on a UK current-account balance as of 21 November 2026: 5% AER fixed for 12 months on the first £1,500, with no monthly fee.** Anything above £1,500 earns no interest, and after the first year the rate drops to 1% AER variable. ([nationwide.co.uk](https://www.nationwide.co.uk/current-accounts/flexdirect))

To get the 5%, you must **pay in £1,500 every month**; transfers from other Nationwide accounts and refunds don’t count. It must also be your first FlexDirect in three years in your sole name, or with the same joint account holder. ([nationwide.co.uk](https://www.nationwide.co.uk/current-accounts/flexdirect))

**If you have more than £1,500 and don’t need it all in your spending account**, consider Santander’s **Edge Saver**. It’s a separate savings account linked to the Edge current account and pays **6% AER variable on up to £4,000**, including a first-year bonus. The Edge current account costs **£3 a month (£36 a year)**, so factor that in when comparing returns. ([santander.co.uk](https://www.santander.co.uk/personal/savings-and-investments/savings/santander-edge-saver?utm_source=openai))
